title.zh: 复盘：问清入口后，仍可选择只看
title.en: Review an explanation with room to watch

paragraphs.zh: 沿用半途到达的纸舞台，先问这一轮在哪一步、现在有哪些加入方式，再选动手、旁观或下轮。得到解释不等于已经答应，也不用掌握所有细节才可试。可以只拟一个问题。复盘看信息是否让选择更清楚，不以问多少或开始快慢评焦虑、勇气、韧性与应对未知的能力。
paragraphs.en: For arriving midway through the paper stage, ask where the round is and which entries remain, then choose trying, watching or another round. Explanation is no agreement, and a trial needs no complete knowledge. Draft one question only. Review clearer choice without grading anxiety, courage, resilience or coping with uncertainty through questions or speed of entry.

title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary paper stage

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果半途来到纸舞台活动，你会先问哪一个问题，再怎样选择加入、旁观或等下一轮？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必表演、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If arriving midway at a paper-stage activity, which question would you ask before joining, watching or waiting?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without performing, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：荒诞变化先讲明，再让大家选
title.en: Review an absurd variation offered openly

paragraphs.zh: 沿用反转一条普通规则的喜剧轮次，先说清会变什么，再把原版并列提供。有人不喜欢，可以保留原版或不演，不拿拒绝者制造笑点。可以只写两版规则。复盘看变化是否经同意、笑点是否留在虚构场景，不以别人不适证明玩得开，也不从角色解释残酷或伤人恶作剧。
paragraphs.en: For a comic round reversing one ordinary rule, explain the change and offer the original alongside it. Keep the original or skip performance if unwanted without making a person’s refusal the joke. Draft two rule versions only. Review agreement and humour within the invented scene, without discomfort as proof of playfulness or character-based explanations for cruelty and harmful pranks.

title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary paper stage

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸舞台想把一条规则倒过来，你会怎样先展示变化，再给原版和不参加的选择？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必表演、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper-stage round reversed a rule, how would you preview it and offer the original and an option to decline?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without performing, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：友好邀请也容得下不同收尾
title.en: Review a welcome with different endings

paragraphs.zh: 沿用活动将结束、精力不同的小组，分别留一小轮、只看和现在结束的办法。自己愿意提供多少也说清，不为了气氛接下所有安排。可以只改邀请卡。复盘看不同选择是否都能被接受，不用快乐回应掩去失望，也不以维持多少人参与评善良、共情或照顾义务。
paragraphs.en: For the ending session with different energy levels, offer one short round, watching or stopping now. State your own offer without taking every arrangement to preserve the mood. Revise an invitation card only. Review accepted differences without a happy response hiding disappointment or participation counts grading goodness, empathy or a duty to care.

title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary paper stage

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸舞台将结束而大家精力不同，你会怎样邀请再玩、只看或现在结束，并说清自己的范围？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必表演、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper-stage session was ending with mixed energy, how would you offer another round, watching or stopping and state your own limits?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without performing, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：画面传达的调子与作者感受分开
title.en: Review an image’s tone separately from its maker

paragraphs.zh: 沿用两种场景调子，只改一处颜色或线条，请愿意的伙伴说各像怎样的虚构片段。不要接着问作者私下是否也这样感受；图可被误读，也可再改。可以只描述，不展示作品。复盘看视觉变化是否服务场景，不把表情当情绪测量、面具后的真相或身份线索。
paragraphs.en: For two scene tones, change one colour or line and ask a willing partner which fictional moment each suggests. Do not ask whether the maker privately feels the same. Images can be read differently and revised. Describe without showing work. Review the scene rather than expressions as emotional measurements, truths behind masks or identity clues.

title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary paper stage

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果同一纸场景只改一种颜色或表情，你会怎样比较传达的调子，而不猜作者真实情绪？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必表演、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If one colour or expression changed in a paper scene, how would you compare its tone without guessing the maker’s feelings?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without performing, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：小印记可以是提示，也可以只是装饰
title.en: Review a mark as a cue or decoration

paragraphs.zh: 沿用道具上没聊过的小印记，先写形状、位置和与旁边物件的关系，再问是否与本轮有关。可能是提示、装饰或误画，暂不解释也可继续。可以只看自制纸物。复盘关注描述是否来自可见内容，不以发现秘密证明记忆、注意力、隐藏能力或应对压力的本领。
paragraphs.en: For the unnoticed prop mark, describe shape, position and nearby objects before asking whether it matters to this round. It may be a cue, decoration or accidental line, and play may continue without an explanation. View a self-made paper object only. Review visible description without secret discoveries as memory, attention, hidden competence or coping under pressure.

title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary paper stage

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果道具上有个小印记，你会先描述哪三点，再怎样确认它是否与玩法有关？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必表演、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a prop had a small mark, which three details would you describe before checking whether it mattered to play?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without performing, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：标准版、改版和旁观都可自选
title.en: Review a standard, customised or watching option

paragraphs.zh: 沿用人人同部件、同角色的提议，分清共享玩法真正必需的部分和可改的外观、参与程度。喜欢标准版就保留，也能改口、未定或只看。可以只改一张角色卡。复盘看选择是否符合当下意愿，不用持续不同证明独立，也不从虚构部件推断身体、性别、倦怠或私密身份。
paragraphs.en: For the proposed identical parts and roles, separate shared-play requirements from appearance and participation choices. Keep the standard if preferred, revise, remain undecided or watch. Edit a role card only. Review present willingness without continual difference as independence or fictional parts as evidence about bodies, gender, burnout or private identity.

title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary paper stage

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果大家提议同一套纸角色，你会问清哪些必需规则，再怎样选标准版、小改或旁观？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必表演、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If everyone was offered the same paper character, which shared requirements would you clarify before choosing the standard, a change or watching?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without performing, attending or disclosing experiences.
